name: Level_1 - Task_6
description: Prepare an equilibrated aluminum state near 300 K for a later vibration calculation. Build a periodic primitive FCC cell with conventional lattice parameter 4.05 Å and repeat it 4 x 4 x 4 to make 64 atoms. Use the supplied MACE-MP-0 model and keep the cell fixed. Initialize Maxwell-Boltzmann velocities at 300 K with a recorded random seed, then remove center-of-mass momentum once. Choose a suitable thermostat, timestep, run length, and sampling interval. Do not reinitialize or rescale the velocities during the run. Save the thermal trace, sampled trajectory, and restartable final state. Use the saved data to show that the state is ready for the later NVE run.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide and fill in only the parts needed for this task. Leave the Level 2 parts empty. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
